name: 往路と復路を切り替える出発時間の条件見出し
prompt:
Create one polished, faithful Japanese mobile UI component for catalog ID LH01-0133, “往路と復路を切り替える出発時間の条件見出し”. The component lets the user choose whether flight-time filters apply to the outbound or return flight, then confirms the departure origin.

Use the original Booking.com screen and exact crop as the authority for control anatomy, order, alignment, selected-tab state, underline, divider, and the visual hierarchy of the departure-origin row. The Japanese mock is secondary and supplies the exact localized wording. The approved heading-marker image is a restrained Lighthouse accent reference only; do not copy its unrelated marker or content.

Render a single isolated component on pure white #FFFFFF, landscape mobile proportions close to 390x170, with no phone frame, surrounding page, screenshot chrome, extra cards, icons, search fields, or buttons. Keep the compact arrangement: bold heading at top; two equal-width horizontal tabs below; “往路” selected and “復路” inactive; a fine neutral divider under the tabs; and one departure-origin row below. Preserve generous enough internal spacing for legibility while staying compact and keeping all content in the canvas.

Use this exact Japanese text and no other copy:
見出し: 出発時間
選択タブ: 往路
非選択タブ: 復路
出発地: ロサンゼルス発

Use Meiryo with the established roles: heading Bold 20 px / 28 px line height, tabs Regular 14 px / 24 px, departure origin Bold 14 px / 24 px, tracking 0. Use dark ink #1D1D1D for primary text, secondary gray #6E6E6E for inactive/quiet text, and Lighthouse forest green #1F6444 for the selected-tab text and its clear underline. Keep the selected underline visible so state is not conveyed by color alone. Use a subtle neutral-gray baseline. Preserve the original white surface and crisp compact hierarchy. Do not introduce blue, broad green fills, glow, gradients, shadows, decorative markers, or additional controls. The result should read as a clean production-ready component, not a redesign of the whole source screen.
reviewNotes: Agent visual review: exact Japanese copy is present; outbound is selected with forest-green text and underline, return is inactive, the neutral baseline and departure-origin row are clear, and the surface is white. The 1900x828 output has the same 390x170 aspect ratio as the saved Japanese mock, so it scales uniformly to the target. Font metrics are not pixel-verifiable from the raster. This is a reviewed image candidate only; no owner approval, editable-source, or implementation claim.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
